credits: Original geometry drawn for Verdant Reach under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md). Botanical reference: Dracaena cinnabari, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dracaena_cinnabari . No sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. Dracaena cinnabari. BRACED: a short thick grey trunk forked once (dichotomous branching), each fork tipped with a dense tuft of stiff upward-pointing swords, the lead tuft lower and forward; a red resin drop hangs from a cut in the bark. Gesture: both tufts flex out and up while the resin bead stretches and a drop falls from the cut, then it settles; trunk, roots and ground stay fixed. Blue-green leaf over a deep resin red-brown that is the resin, the bark shading and the crown's underside (dark slot); white ridges on the lit side make the bark grey. Sport: the paler grey-green foliage of the related Canary Islands dragon tree (Dracaena draco).
